messages:
samir: deploy-bot blocked staging->prod promotion for payments-service; postup hook job/payments-migrate failed. staging chart 3.4.0, prod 3.3.2; eu-west overlay added migratorRole and db.poolSize. @mike can you triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion blocked: postupgrade hook failed (exit 1). logs: https://deploy/logs/1778888888. auto-retry paused pending human action.

mike: logs show `psql: error: role "payments_migrator" does not exist` in migration container. staging overlay introduced `migratorRole`. @ashley did you add that?

ashley: yes — I added `migratorRole: payments_migrator` and bumped migration image in staging for schema v5. I missed prod overlay. Options: patch prod overlay now and retry, or pin prod to 3.3.2 and schedule coordinated change window.

irene: prefer pin + scheduled change window for DB changes. live role changes outside a window are risky.

samir: plan: abort promotion, pin payments-service to chart 3.3.2, add release-tracker hold note, schedule migration window 2026-04-12 10:00 UTC. mike/ashley to prepare runbook. I'll apply pin.

mike: running `deployctl pin --service payments-service --chart 3.3.2 --reason "prod overlay missing migratorRole"`. confirm deploy-bot will not auto-retry?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] auto-retry suppressed for pinned promotions. Pin recorded by samir at 1778888925.

samir: pin applied, promotion aborted. draft release-note: "Hold: payments-service promotion blocked due to missing migrator DB role in prod overlay; pinned to 3.3.2. Follow-up migration & overlay update scheduled 2026-04-12 10:00 UTC." Added to release tracker.

ashley: PR opened for prod overlay: https://git/repo/prod-overlay/pull/999 — adds `migratorRole: payments_migrator` and migration image. Runbook in PR includes: preflight checks (db role exists), staged migration commands, verification steps, and rollback instructions (reapply previous schema + restore from pre-migration snapshot).

mike: CI preflight snippet to ensure role exists: `kubectl run --rm migrate-check --image=psql-client -- sh -c "psql -c \"SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='payments_migrator'\""` — CI will block promotion if it fails. I'll also add a canary job that runs the migration in a shadow tenant before promotion.

release-manager: I'll review the runbook during the change window. Note: if migration is destructive, we'll postpone to twilight window and ensure backups and failback are tested.

samir: thanks. holding until change window sign-off. tracker: https://redwood-inference/release-tracker/1778888888 ✅
